title: Category stratification contract
description: A category's declared, machine-checkable coverage contract. Each authoring ticket (GOLD-05 … GOLD-14) ships one `stratification.yaml` in its own category directory; this schema is what makes their claims verifiable without reading their content — which is the only way a BLIND category can be checked at all.
$comment: VOCABULARY. Inside the subset `contracts.jsonschema_min` (CRPS-01) implements — no minItems, uniqueItems, format, propertyNames or patternProperties. Floors are expressed as explicit {key, minimum} rows rather than as an open object, precisely because propertyNames/patternProperties are unavailable and an unchecked open map would be data no check ever validated. Q-GOLD-C: PRD §43.1's 'at least eight primary cases in each applicable nationwide category must cover each state/territory' is not satisfiable for adjacent-regimes (8 × 8 = 64 > 60 primary cases), so the per-jurisdiction floor is DECLARED per category here rather than derived, and the Founder owns the value. STRATIFICATION_MET never relaxes ALLOCATION_EXACT, which is requirement EVAL-001 itself.

category.description: The category directory slug this contract governs.

code.description: The three-letter case-id code (sub-PRD D5), which must agree with evals/splits/allocation.yaml.

counts.description: The category's PRD §43.1 row, restated so a category is self-describing. ALLOCATION_EXACT asserts it equals evals/splits/allocation.yaml exactly — not 'at least'.

jurisdiction_floors.description: PRD §43.1 per-jurisdiction coverage. Declared, not derived — see the Q-GOLD-C note in $comment.

product_surface_floors.description: PRD §43.1 'cross-tags ensure every product surface … is represented'. The allocation is in the sub-PRD's cross-cutting floor table.

answer_status_floors.description: PRD §43.1 '… and answer status is represented'. Keys are canonical AnswerStatus members, enforced from the packages/contracts export by STRATIFICATION_MET rather than restated here.

required_trap_types.description: Trap types that must appear at least once in this category (PRD §14.1's time traps, conflicts, PII, malicious avoidance).

notes.description: Optional prose. Never a place to weaken a floor — a floor change is a docs PR against this ticket and the authoring ticket.
